text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. 1 May YHWH answer you in the day of distress; may the name of the God of Jacob set you on high.
May He send help for you from the Holy Place, and from Zion may He support you.
May He remember all your gifts, and anoint your burnt offering. Selah
may He give to you according to your heart, and fulfill all your counsel.
We will rejoice in your salvation, and we will raise a banner in the name of our God; may YHWH fulfill all your petitions.
Now I know that YHWH brings salvation [for] His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven, with the saving might of His right hand.
These in the chariots, and these in the horses, but we, in the name of YHWH our God, will remember.
They have bowed down and fallen, and we have risen and stand upright.
O YHWH, save the king! Answer us on the day we call.
